# One mention among several is the principal one

A term is usually discussed properly in one place and mentioned in passing in
others. `mention="principal"` says which occurrence is the proper one, and each
back-end emphasizes that locator alone. The three marks below are deliberately
on three different pages: a probe that put them on one page could not tell an
emphasized locator from an emphasized entry.

The first passing mention: [basilisk]{.index}.

{{< pagebreak >}}

The principal discussion, a page later: [basilisk]{.index mention="principal"}.

{{< pagebreak >}}

A second passing mention, a page later still: [basilisk]{.index}.

{{< pagebreak >}}

# A role on a mark that can carry no locator

A cross-reference takes the place of a locator, so a mark carrying one has no
locator to emphasize. The role is reported and ignored, and the mark indexes
exactly as it would with the attribute removed — which is what the twin fixture
beside this one renders:
[cockatrice]{.index mention="principal" see="basilisk"}.

# Values the extension does not recognize

A value that names no role the extension knows. It is reported and the mark
indexes as though the attribute were absent: [dryad]{.index mention="paramount"}.

An empty value, which is a value the author wrote rather than an attribute they
omitted, and so is reported the same way: [ettin]{.index mention=""}.

{{< pagebreak >}}

# The control this milestone must leave alone

A term marked twice with no role anywhere. Every report this milestone adds must
stay silent on it, and both its locators must stay plain: [faun]{.index} here,

{{< pagebreak >}}

and [faun]{.index} a page later.

{{< pagebreak >}}

# A principal locator on a key that also carries a cross-reference

A styled locator is not a rival encapsulation — makeindex prints a plain and a
styled page number side by side — so this key is contested only by its
cross-reference, and the existing repair folds that into the entry's printed
text because the key does have a locator mark. The locator mark, which is the
principal one: [gorgon]{.index mention="principal"}.

{{< pagebreak >}}

The cross-reference mark on the same key, a page later, which contributes no
locator of its own: [gorgon]{.index see="basilisk"}.
